checks.label: Fits in 5 days
checks.reason: Exactly five day headings, numbered Day 1 to Day 5, no gaps and no repeats. Days 1 to 4 carry 3 slots each, day 5 carries 2 (Fushimi Inari plus the departure block), so no day is empty.

checks.label: Includes Tokyo, Kyoto
checks.reason: Tokyo gets full days 1 and 2 with 2 nights in Nishiasakusa. Kyoto gets full days 4 and 5 with 2 nights in Shimogyo. Day 3 is the transfer day and still lands two Kyoto slots.

checks.label: Within $3000
checks.reason: Recomputed from the budget lines: stay 380.00 + transport 133.48 + food 212.50 + activities 30.00 = 755.98 subtotal, buffer 10% = 75.60, total $831.58 against the $3,000 limit, 27.7% of budget. The stated total matches the recomputation to the cent.

checks.label: Matches food, temples
checks.reason: All 5 days carry at least one food or temple slot. Day 1 Tsukiji (food) and Senso-ji (temple), day 2 Nezu Shrine and Meiji Jingu (temple) plus Yakitori Alley (food), day 3 chao chao gyoza and Shinkyogoku (food), day 4 Kiyomizu-dera and Kodaiji (temple) plus Nishiki Market (food), day 5 Fushimi Inari Taisha (temple). 6 temple slots and 6 food slots across the trip.

checks.label: Avoids crowds
checks.reason: All 12 venue slots carry a tactic with a specific time or place, not a generic line. Examples: Fushimi Inari at 06:00 or hike past the second rest house, Kiyomizu-dera at 07:30 opening, Nezu Shrine on a weekday afternoon outside the April azalea dates, Yakitori Alley at 17:30 opening. The two 'n/a, not a venue' entries sit on the Shinkansen leg and the day 5 packing block. Warning, not a fail: the Shinkansen leg does have a real tactic (reserved Nozomi seats, crowd section item 4) that was not carried into the slot row.

checks.label: Travel time realistic
checks.reason: Day 3 allots 195 min for the inter-city move, which is the 135 min Nozomi duration from the logistics table plus a 60 min station buffer, exactly the required allowance. The largest intra-city leg anywhere in the plan is 31 min (day 4, Kiyomizu-dera to Nishiki Market), well under the 90 min ceiling. Warning, not a fail: the day 3 afternoon row repeats 195 in the transit column, which restates the same Tokyo to Kyoto leg instead of giving the short Kyoto Station to Nakagyo hop.
